Definition: from G2596 and a derivative of G4632; to prepare thoroughly (properly, by external equipment; whereas G2090 refers rather to internal fitness); by implication, to construct, create:--build, make, ordain, prepare.
BiblicalUsage: To prepare thoroughly is what Noah did when he built the ark, what God does as the builder of every house, what was written for the messenger to prepare the way before the Lord, and what John the Baptist came to do for a people prepared for the Lord. The word holds the ark, the house, and the way together: God prepares, and His people prepare, and the preparation is the point.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God prepares the way before He walks it, and He asks me to prepare my heart the same way. I hold that Noah's ark is the picture of a prepared faith, and John's preaching is the picture of a prepared people.
